kind: Constructed object-map version regression based on the artificial native APFS device fixture; not a native snapshot-producer sample.
mutation: Container object-map leaf has an older, current and future version of the same volume object. Only the current version references a readable block. Entries remain sorted by object identifier and transaction; key counts and Fletcher checksum are updated.

negative_cases.deleted: The current mapping is a deletion marker; the otherwise readable address must not be used.
negative_cases.unordered: Two object-map keys are swapped; input order remains invalid even when a readable mapping exists.
